correctness.rationale: For a smooth homogeneous degree d>1 GAS field, a C² positive-Hessian Lyapunov L has leading gradient λHz along rays and gives zᵀHf(z)≤0. Conversely a positive definite weak quadratic Q plus an existing smooth proper strict GAS converse Lyapunov W is smooth, proper, strict and has positive Hessian; the converse theorem is explicitly assumed. For the cubic family the quartic W=(x⁴+y⁴)/4 has derivative −x⁶−y⁶<0 for all κ, proving GAS. C4 equivariance averages an arbitrary admissible H to a positive scalar I. The exact identity (x⁴+y⁴)²−8x²y²(y²−x²)²=(x⁴−4x²y²+y⁴)² shows the sharp radial ratio 1/(2sqrt(2)); extremal rays attain it. Hence |κ|≤2sqrt(2) precisely, including endpoint via x²+y²+εW; outside no local even weak C² Morse certificate. I independently checked the polynomial and rotational identities symbolically; no unverified numerical inference supplies the universal necessity.

originality.rationale: Jongeneel 2026 establishes hyperbolic Morse sufficiency and linear semisimplicity necessity, including non-Morse examples, not the global-if-and-only-if for homogeneous GAS fields or this sharp explicit C4 family. Liu–Fitzsimmons give a distinct cubic GAS field lacking any homogeneous polynomial/analytic Lyapunov certificate, whereas this family always has a quartic polynomial certificate and changes only Morse regularity at |κ|=2sqrt(2). The polynomial and matrix averaging ingredients are conventional; the combined sharp all-parameter certificate existence law was not directly implied by examined sources.
residual_risks: Classical homogeneous converse and quadratic Lyapunov inequality literature might have already stated the general add-Q equivalence.
General symmetry-averaging obstruction is standard, so priority rests on its sharp new homogeneous certificate classification.

value.rationale: The homogeneous criterion converts a smooth-function existence problem into a concrete weak quadratic feasibility test; the planar family has a sharp Morse-certificate transition while global stability and a strict quartic certificate remain unchanged. This separates certificate regularity from dynamical bifurcation and addresses a nonhyperbolic case the motivating prior work leaves open.
